section: Environmental Studies · Ch40 — Food, Health & Nutrition
subject: Environmental Studies
stem: A child suffering from night blindness is most likely deficient in which vitamin?
explanation: Vitamin A deficiency causes night blindness. Vitamin C deficiency causes scurvy; Vitamin D deficiency causes rickets; B12 deficiency causes pernicious anaemia.

section: Environmental Studies · Ch44 — Universe & Solar System
subject: Environmental Studies
stem: Which planet in our solar system is known as the 'Red Planet' due to iron oxide on its surface?
explanation: Mars appears reddish due to iron oxide covering much of its surface. Venus is the hottest planet; Jupiter is the largest; Mercury is closest to the Sun.

section: Environmental Studies · Ch44 — Universe & Solar System
subject: Environmental Studies
stem: Day and night occur on Earth mainly because of the Earth's:
explanation: Earth's rotation on its own axis causes day and night. Revolution around the Sun (once a year) causes seasons, not day-night.

section: Environmental Studies · Ch41 — Matter & Natural Resources
subject: Environmental Studies
stem: The process by which water vapour in the atmosphere turns back into liquid water droplets, forming clouds, is called:
explanation: Condensation is vapour turning to liquid (cloud formation). Evaporation is liquid turning to vapour; precipitation is water falling as rain/snow; transpiration is water vapour released by plants.

section: Environmental Studies · Ch41 — Matter & Natural Resources
subject: Environmental Studies
stem: Coal, petroleum and natural gas are called fossil fuels because they:

options.option_text: Formed over millions of years from the remains of dead plants and animals
Can be regenerated within a few years of use

explanation: Fossil fuels form over millions of years from decomposed organic matter under heat and pressure, which is why they are non-renewable — they cannot be replenished on a human timescale.
